C. I. D.
F. O. REG
No.........204
Date......28/3/16

Municipal Police.
CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION DEPT.
Captain Superintendent's Office,

Shanghai, March 28th 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that two members of the Manchu party
named Tih Liang 鐵良 and Sung Yuin 升允 have come to
Shanghai from Tsingtao and are now conferring with the
local rebels.
It is reported that the rebels in Shanghai
sent arms and ammunition to Tahu on 26th instant.
It is reported that Zau Lien Whang 趙聯璜 one of
General Yang's staff officers, is acting as spy for the
rebels.
Cablegrams are constantly being exchanged between
the Shanghai rebels and the Chinese emigrants
in the Straits, Japan and America.
It is reported that the Chiangchun of Fokien has
sent a telegram to General Yang saying that Canton
has declared independence and that the Chiangchun
of that province has absconded.
One hundred and eighty recruits arrived
in Woosung this morning from North.

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（左侧手写批注：K. 29/3）

刑事调查处
外交部登记
编号……204
日期……1916年3月28日

公共租界警务处。
刑事调查科，
警司办公室，

上海，1916年3月28日。

先生：

据报，满党成员铁良（Tih Liang）和升允（Sung Yuin）已从青岛抵达上海，现正与当地反叛分子进行磋商。

据报，上海的反叛分子于本月26日向大虎（Tahu）运送了武器弹药。

据报，杨将军的参谋军官之一赵联璜（Zau Lien Whang）正在为反叛分子充当间谍。

上海反叛分子与海峡殖民地、日本及美国的中国流亡者之间不断交换电报。

据报，福建督军已致电杨将军，称广东已宣布独立，且该省督军已潜逃。

一百八十名新兵今晨从北方抵达吴淞。

您的恭顺仆人，

（签名）
总探长。

警务处警司。

（左侧手写批注：K. 3/29）
